title: Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14162v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning

translated_title: 下一概念建模：快速、并行的由粗到细文本生成
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型（DLM）具有并行采样能力，生成速度比自回归模型更快——随着推理成为主导性的计算负载，这一优势日益重要。然而，DLM在采样步数减少时性能会迅速下降，每一步都需要处理完整序列，并且需要对数据集进行多次遍历才能达到良好质量。我们提出了下一概念建模（Next-Concept Modeling, NCM），这是一个两阶段、由粗到细的框架：首先由一个多尺度残差VQ-VAE将文本编码为层级化的离散码，然后由一个Transformer逐层生成，在每一层内并行预测所有码。在参数规模匹配的条件下，NCM在LM1B上以快21倍的速度取得了优于最强DLM基线的生成困惑度；在OpenWebText上，NCM与最强DLM性能相当但速度快10倍；在XSum上，它以快31倍的速度达到了最强DLM的ROUGE-L水平。
tldr: 提出两阶段由粗到细的下一概念建模（NCM）框架，利用多尺度残差VQ-VAE将文本编码为层级离散码并由Transformer逐层并行生成，在质量与最强扩散语言模型相当或更优的同时实现最高31倍的生成加速。
en_tdlr: Next-Concept Modeling (NCM) is a two-stage coarse-to-fine framework that uses a multiscale residual VQ-VAE to encode text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, which a transformer generates level-by-level in parallel, achieving comparable or better quality than diffusion language models with up to 31× speedup.
